stories.headline: Trump, Xi and Putin meet in Shenzhen in first-ever trilateral
stories.dek: Xi, Trump and Putin open the first three-way summit talks on Thursday in Shenzhen; a Wednesday handshake set the stage.
stories.scene_caption: THREE LEADERS, ONE TABLE IN SHENZHEN

stories.headline: Kerch Bridge hit a third time in a week
stories.dek: A span fell Tuesday; traffic halts for a 3rd time in 7 days as crews assess damage. — Reuters

stories.headline: Iran says three tankers hit mines and catch fire
stories.dek: Tehran says the vessels entered a restricted zone with tracking off; a 4th tanker was also hit. — AP
stories.scene_caption: THREE TANKERS ON FIRE IN THE GULF

stories.headline: Bahrain and Kuwait repel Iran drone attacks
stories.dek: Interceptors knock the drones down over 2 Gulf states; no damage or casualties reported. — Reuters

stories.headline: Ebola outbreak still expanding, WHO warns
stories.dek: Cases reach 11,536 with deaths topping 5,600; 400 to 500 new cases arrive each week. — WHO

stories.headline: Cyclone Akvan turns very severe off India's coast
stories.dek: Winds gust to 130 km/h with rain over 21 cm; landfall is due Friday on the Andhra coast. — IMD

stories.headline: World Court to rule today on Myanmar genocide case
stories.dek: Gambia brought the case in 2019 over the 2017 Rohingya campaign; judges read the ruling today. — AP

stories.headline: COP31 draft splits ministers as talks near the end
stories.dek: Ministers split over the draft as OPEC defends fossil fuels; a 35% power target for 2035 is backed. — Reuters

stories.headline: Nvidia posts record quarter; ends China chip sales
stories.dek: Revenue roughly doubles year on year as Kress halts H200 chip shipments to China. — Bloomberg

stories.headline: Dow slides as Fed minutes point to more rate hikes
stories.dek: UnitedHealth sinks 10% on a Medicare audit plan; the index falls a 5th straight day. — Reuters
stories.scene_caption: WALL STREET SLIDES ON FED MINUTES

stories.headline: Gaza's tents fail as winter rain floods the camps
stories.dek: Aid groups say 150,000 tents sit blocked at the border as a 4th winter closes in. — AP

stories.headline: U.S. loses measles elimination status after 26 years
stories.dek: Cases climb to a record 5,412 with 10 deaths as PAHO ends the status held since 2000. — AP

stories.headline: GTA VI launches to a 99 Metacritic score
stories.dek: Rockstar's sequel lands after a 13-year wait to a 99 Metacritic score; queues form at midnight. — IGN

stories.headline: Houthis seize Red Sea coast posts as forces pull back
stories.dek: Government forces pull back to defend Aden; the Saudi-led coalition strikes back.
stories.brief: ADEN — Houthis seize Red Sea coast posts.

stories.headline: Estonia to shut its Russia border from December 1
stories.dek: Tallinn blames the GRU for a foiled drone-factory sabotage; eight suspects are held.
stories.brief: TALLINN — Estonia shuts its Russia border.

stories.headline: EU offers Ukraine a €45bn loan tied to reparations
stories.dek: Kyiv repays only after Russian reparations; leaders discuss it next week.
stories.brief: BRUSSELS — EU offers a €45bn Ukraine loan.

stories.headline: Bangladesh flips the switch on its first nuclear unit
stories.dek: Rooppur's first unit feeds 350 MW to the grid in a trial; full power follows a 10-month test.
stories.brief: DHAKA — Bangladesh starts its first reactor.

stories.headline: Trump plotter jailed for 27 years
stories.dek: Asif Merchant gets 330 months for the Iran-backed 2024 assassination plot.
stories.brief: NEW YORK — Trump plotter gets 27 years.

stories.headline: Libya seizes four million pills and cocaine in Derna
stories.dek: Eastern authorities break a drug gang; the UN calls Libya a transit hub.
stories.brief: DERNA — Libya seizes 4m pills and cocaine.

stories.headline: Haiti signs El Salvador security deal
stories.dek: Cabinet approves the pact as Bukele's troops fight gangs; crowds cheer in the streets.
stories.brief: PORT-AU-PRINCE — Haiti signs security deal.

stories.headline: Earthshot winners take £1m each in Mumbai
stories.dek: William hands five prizes in Mumbai, from Bhutan's forests to ocean protection.
stories.brief: MUMBAI — Earthshot winners take £1m each.

stories.headline: Pew: Muslims to top Christians by 2035
stories.dek: Pew projects Islam passes Christianity as the world's largest religion by 2035, on faster birth rates.
stories.brief: WASHINGTON — Pew projects a Muslim lead by 2035.

stories.headline: Saudi Arabia says danger has passed in the south
stories.dek: Civil defence lifts alerts in Jazan, Najran and Khamis Mushait after Houthi fire.
stories.brief: JAZAN — Saudi says the danger has passed.

stories.headline: Hegseth signs Venezuela defence pact
stories.dek: The U.S. and Venezuela restore military ties; he then lands in Bogota with a C-130.
stories.brief: CARACAS — Hegseth signs a Venezuela pact.

stories.headline: Anthropic prices its IPO at $83 a share
stories.dek: The AI firm raises about $81bn; shares start trading Thursday as ANT.
stories.brief: NEW YORK — Anthropic prices its IPO at $83.

stories.headline: Microsoft offers buyouts to 60,000 staff
stories.dek: Nadella says AI is reshaping roles; staff have until early December to accept.
stories.brief: REDMOND — Microsoft offers 60,000 buyouts.

stories.headline: Last local militant killed in Kashmir
stories.dek: Lateef Bhat dies in a mosque standoff in Kulgam; police call him LeT's last local man.
stories.brief: SRINAGAR — Last local militant is killed.

stories.headline: Quad sets up a business leaders' forum
stories.dek: The four nations agree a business forum and deeper maritime, cyber and AI cooperation.
stories.brief: MANILA — Quad launches a business forum.

stories.headline: U.S. reissues security warnings in Bahrain and Saudi Arabia
stories.dek: The State Department renews warnings for citizens in Bahrain and Saudi Arabia as the Gulf crisis deepens.
stories.brief: BAHRAIN — U.S. reissues security warnings.

stories.headline: Minister warns Mélenchon could win the French presidency
stories.dek: Darmanin says the hard-left leader could win a 2027 runoff against Le Pen; polls still favour Le Pen.
stories.brief: PARIS — Mélenchon could win the presidency.

stories.headline: Senators warn AI cyber threats are outpacing defences
stories.dek: Cantwell and Rounds tell the White House to act; a GAO test got attack plans from four chatbots.
stories.brief: WASHINGTON — Senators warn on AI threats.

stories.headline: Grand jury indicts man in foiled Hindu temple plot
stories.dek: Paporakis, 19, faces new terrorism charges over the October 11 plan at the Balaji Temple; his rifle jammed.
stories.brief: AURORA — Temple plotter faces new charges.

stories.headline: India and Japan hold their fourth 2+2 dialogue
stories.dek: Singh and Jaishankar meet Koizumi and Motegi in Tokyo to review defence and Indo-Pacific ties.
stories.brief: TOKYO — India and Japan hold 2+2 talks.

stories.headline: Colombia rejects joint U.S. plan against drug gangs
stories.dek: De La Espriella tells Washington he lacks the votes in Congress; Hegseth cuts his Bogota visit short.
stories.brief: BOGOTA — Colombia rejects a joint U.S. plan.

stories.headline: France jails three women for joining ISIS in Syria
stories.dek: A Paris court sentences the women to up to 12 years for joining jihadists in Syria in 2015.
stories.brief: PARIS — France jails three women over ISIS.

stories.headline: Auckland mayor says democracy has had its day
stories.dek: Wayne Brown lauds China's one-party system after a Guangzhou trip; the U.S. ambassador rebukes him.
stories.brief: AUCKLAND — Mayor praises one-party rule.

stories.headline: Fiona the hippo must pass a swallowed hat on her own
stories.dek: Surgery is not an option; vets use a vibration plate and round-the-clock care after a colonoscopy.
stories.brief: CINCINNATI — Fiona the hippo must pass a hat.

stories.headline: Carney pitches Canada as Asia-Pacific energy power
stories.dek: Canada extends tariff relief with China and pledges to quadruple LNG exports to Asia by 2030.
stories.brief: SHENZHEN — Carney pitches Canada to Asia.

stories.headline: Ukraine says it hit two Russian refineries
stories.dek: Kyiv says tanks burned at Ilsky and a unit was hit at Afipsky; Zelenskyy hails home-made weapons.
stories.brief: KRASNODAR — Ukraine hits two refineries.

stories.headline: Alcaraz reaches the ATP Finals last four
stories.dek: Alcaraz beats Medvedev 6-2, 6-4 in Turin; Tiafoe's first Finals win knocks out Cobolli.
stories.brief: TURIN — Alcaraz reaches the ATP semifinals.

stories.headline: Thailand rushes clean water to arsenic-hit villages
stories.dek: Tap water to 14 villages is cut after arsenic hits 30 times the safe limit; 20,000 households affected.
stories.brief: CHIANG RAI — Arsenic hits 30x safe limit.

stories.headline: Voyager 1 reaches one light-day from Earth
stories.dek: NASA's 1977 probe crosses a threshold no spacecraft has crossed; its signal now takes a full day to arrive.
stories.brief: PASADENA — Voyager 1 reaches one light-day.

stories.headline: Tiafoe scores his first ATP Finals win
stories.dek: Tiafoe's first Finals win knocks out Cobolli in Turin.
stories.brief: TURIN — Tiafoe wins his first Finals match.
